rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one undergoing cutting
optative expressing potential or counterfactual result
compound indicating absorption or attainment of that state
compound indicating mental absorption in that state

items.question: Can a person absorbed in that state be harmed when physically cut?
premises: A person may be physically subjected to cutting.
That person can be absorbed in that higher state.
That person can have the mind fixed on that state.
items.inference: One who has gone to that state and fixed the mind on it is not truly cut even while being cut.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'that' (tad) depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Just as one who has reached that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not cut, even while being cut.
